change: CAP-008 is the designated federation-UX owner and changes frontend files, so the CAP-005 invariant 'the frontend is byte-identical to CAPSTONE_UI_V1' cannot remain a future invariant. (1) scripts/verify_capstone_ui_v1.py now accepts a changed UI_V1-bound file ONLY if the CAPSTONE_UI_V1_1 successor lock (artifacts/capstone/CAPSTONE_UI_V1_1.lock.json) binds exactly the current bytes; every other deviation still raises CAPSTONE_UI_V1_TAMPER. (2) tests/test_capstone_frontend.py: the tamper test shadows the successor lock too, and the shell test now requires the federation/models pages to exist (real) while the research pages remain placeholders. (3) frontend/src/lib/product/api.ts (a CAP-005-bound file) gains the nine CAP-007 client methods. The CAPSTONE_UI_V1 lock file itself is NOT modified; CAPSTONE_UI_V1_1 binds every frontend file and scripts/verify_capstone_ui_v1_1.py fails on any unaccounted frontend drift.
defect: Historical guard incompatibility (not an implementation defect): the CAP-005 verifier/tests assume the frontend never changes after CAP-005.
made_during: CAP-008, in its own commit before the CAP-008 method freeze and before gate evaluation
